shortTitle: Overweight and obesity from EHRs and Kiosks in Obesity
longTitle: National, state, and county estimates of adult overweight and obesity from electronic health records and kiosks
summary: In the absence of objectively measured weight data from national surveys at the county level, we used EHR data from Epic Cosmos and user data from Pursuant Health kiosks to estimate prevalence of overweight and obesity.
citation: Varghese J.S., Hsiao T.W. et.al. National, state, and county estimates of adult overweight and obesity from electronic health records and kiosks. Obesity. 2026. doi:10.1111/oby.70141
